title: Encouragement in Suffering
definition: Encouragement in suffering is the ministry of strengthening weary hearts with God's truth, presence, promises, comfort, and hope.
summary: Suffering can isolate and discourage. God comforts His people and calls them to comfort one another with the comfort they have received from Him.
christFocus: Christ comforts His suffering people and gives hope that pain will not have the final word.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Suffering can isolate and discourage. God comforts His people and calls them to comfort one another with the comfort they have received from Him.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, think biblically, love others rightly, and live with wisdom, humility, and hope.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your relationships, choices, service, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
